title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 384, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Power cost charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of October, November and December 1986. Application is also made by Cambridge Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. No. 386. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
